company.shortDescription: Orbio is a data fusion platform to help companies reduce their methane emissions
company.description:
Orbio helps energy companies reduce methane emissions. 

We do this by fusing satellite data with ground data to help environmental engineers and asset operators develop effective emission reduction strategies on the ground.
